title: Low-Cost Microchip & Vaccination Clinic This Saturday
content: Hope for Strays is hosting a walk-in microchip (RM 35) and core vaccination clinic at our Petaling Jaya facility this Saturday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM. Open to all pet owners across Selangor. Dogs must be on leash; cats must be in secure carriers.
author: Veterinary Team

title: Urgent: Temporary Foster Homes Needed in Petaling Jaya
content: We took in two litters of orphaned 4-week-old kittens today in SS2 that need 2–3 weeks of foster care before they can be vaccinated. All kitten milk replacer, feeding supplies, and medical checkups are fully sponsored by Hope for Strays.
author: Foster Coordinator

title: Video Update: Toby Settling into His New Home in Subang Jaya
content: Toby's adoptive family sent us this heartwarming video of his first week! Toby was rescued from an industrial park in Section 19 and underwent orthopedic surgery. Watch his video update below.
author: Adoption Coordinator

title: Adoption Promotion: Senior Rescue Pets Fee Fully Sponsored
content: Thanks to a private community donor in Selangor, all adoption fees for senior rescue dogs and cats aged 6 years and older are fully sponsored this month. Includes full bloodwork, dental cleaning, and microchip.
author: Shelter Team
